newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung in Russian helicopter sales deal.
newsitem.headline: Samsung in Russian helicopter sales deal.

text.p: Samsung Aerospace said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Russia's Rostvertol to be the sole agent for its Mi-26 helicopter in Asia-Pacific.
The two companies would cooperate on sales, after-sales support and modernisation of the helicopter model, it said.
It also said Samsung had agreed to buy a Mi-26 heavylift helicopter at $12 million from the Russian company for delivery by January.
